items.title: Google Expands Ads In AI Mode To 10+ Countries, Adds Multiturn Ads
items.excerpt: Google is expanding ads in AI Mode to 10+ English-language countries and launching multiturn ads (ads on follow-up queries) in the U.S., with notes on what PPC advertisers get in reporting.

items.title: Meta Paused Its New Business Terms, And Businesses Should Plan As If It Never Gets Better
items.excerpt: Meta removed 'train' from the crawl clause of its updated business and ad terms, kept 'develop', then paused the Nov. 20 terms entirely after advertiser pushback over AI use of business website content.

items.title: OpenAI's new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it's also selling as an ad

items.title: Reddit Taps Qloo To Strengthen Its Predictive Targeting
items.excerpt: Through a partnership with Qloo's taste-correlation AI model, Reddit will target users with relevant ads based on correlated interests without needing search queries or browsing history.

items.title: TIME's AI Agents Do The Coordinating, And Its Sellers Still Do The Selling

items.excerpt: Priceline is the first travel brand to use AI Sponsored Snaps, which let advertisers bring their own chatbots into Snapchat, putting its Penny AI agent in ads.

items.title: Synthetic audiences fall short: What marketers need to know
items.excerpt: AI-generated audience simulations may make it harder for brands to reach new audiences, argues RYA co-founder Mark Himmelsbach.

items.title: Adobe and Pepsi ads ran on AI recipe sites with fake chefs, DecryptAds finds
